raw_response: {"diagnosis":"raw_transactions has 4972 rows but only 4827 distinct txn_ids, so some transactions were re-delivered in later batches. silver_transactions has no dedup step, so each re-delivered POSTED row is loaded again and inflates counts and totals in every gold table. I assume the copies are re-deliveries of the same transaction, so I keep the latest delivery per txn_id.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.7,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') WHERE rn = 1;"}}
